title: Services Detail
description: Detailed service cards with icon, description, benefits list, pricing, and CTA buttons.

default.title: Septic Tank Pumping
default.description: Routine septic tank pumping is the single most important thing you can do to protect your system. We recommend pumping every 3–5 years depending on household size and tank capacity.

default.title: Septic Inspections
default.description: Our thorough septic inspections include a full system evaluation, tank pumping if needed, video inspection, and a detailed written report — essential for home purchases and routine maintenance.

default.title: New System Installations
default.description: Planning a new home or replacing a failed system? Our installation team handles everything — site evaluation, permit acquisition, excavation, system installation, and final inspection.

default.title: Septic Repairs
default.description: From broken pipes to failing pumps, our diagnostic team quickly identifies and fixes any septic system issue. We carry common parts on our trucks for same-day repairs whenever possible.

default.title: Drain Field Services
default.description: A failing drain field doesn't always mean full replacement. Our restoration services can extend the life of your drain field at a fraction of the cost of a new system installation.

default.title: 24/7 Emergency Service
default.description: Septic emergencies don't wait for business hours. Our emergency team is on standby around the clock, ready to respond within 1–2 hours to sewage backups, overflows, and system failures.

default.title: Aerobic Systems
default.description: Aerobic treatment systems are ideal for smaller lots, poor soil conditions, or environmentally sensitive areas. We install, maintain, and repair all major aerobic system brands.

default.title: Grease Trap Cleaning
default.description: Restaurants and food service businesses require regular grease trap maintenance to stay compliant and odor-free. We offer scheduled service plans with service certificates for inspectors.
